text:
jess: Heads-up  just pushed the KV-prefetch + request-coalescer canary this morning. Short summary: p50 -9%, p95 -23%, estimated infra cost per 1M tokens -33% on the tested workload. :sparkles:

omar: Nice! What's the workload mix for the canary?

jess: 120k requests, 60/40 chat vs. completions, median seq len ~48, 95th pct seq ~620. We targeted short-chat heavy tenants first.

trin: What exactly is "KV-prefetch" here?

jess: Two parts: 1) a lightweight predictive prefetcher that pulls likely KV-cache prefixes for ongoing conversations (based on recent prefix hashes), and 2) a coalescer that groups tiny independent requests into a single KV read op to reduce RPC overhead. Both are conservative - only for sessions with >2 turns in 30s.

perf-bot: Canary report (canary=kvpref-2026-06-10): requests=120,312, error rate unchanged (0.03% -> 0.03%), p50 48ms -> 44ms, p95 248ms -> 191ms, token cost projection 0.75 -> 0.50 USD per 1k tokens. Full dashboards: https://internal.redwood/perf/kvpref-2026-06-10

kat: Any regressions or gotchas?

jess: No user-visible regressions. Observed 8% more host CPU in cases where prefix churn is extreme (many short sessions with unique prefixes). We added a soft cap (prefetch_concurrency=16) to protect hosts. Also fall back to no-prefetch if memory pressure > 85% for the process.

omar: Can you paste the config snippet?

jess: Sure:

```
kv_prefetch:
  enabled: true
  lookahead_turns: 2
  prefetch_concurrency: 16
  session_min_turns: 2
  backoff_ms: 40
coalescer:
  enabled: true
  max_coalesce_window_ms: 6
  max_coalesced_requests: 8
```

trin: Rollout plan?

jess: Progressive: canary -> 3% -> 20% (4h) -> 60% (24h) -> 100% (48h). Auto-rollback if p95 increases >4% or error rate delta >0.15%. Monitoring checks added.

kat: Please add this to the model-runbook and the onboarding checklist. Model owners should know prefetch may slightly bias cache stats.

jess: Will do. Also adding a short note about the host CPU soft-cap behavior.

deploy-bot: Rollout started at 1781240000, current traffic 3%. Canary job kvpref-2026-06-10 complete.

perf-bot: Cost tracker updated: if effect holds on fleet, projected monthly infra token spend down ~30-35% for conversation-heavy tiers. Logged under COST-2026-06-KV.

omar: Can we get a 1-paragraph blurb for Thursday all-hands? Ops + cost wins look great.

jess: On it  will DM a draft and drop a screenshot of the p95 waterfall.

trin: Quick follow-up idea: add a tiny ML model to predict prefix reuse probability instead of heuristics. Worth a spike.

jess: Agree, adding spike to backlog.

kat: :thumbsup: great work team.
